newsitem.title: USA: NTN says sees oper loss possibly into Q2.
newsitem.headline: NTN says sees oper loss possibly into Q2.

text.p: NTN Communications Inc said Thursday it expects to report a fourth quarter loss of apporximately $16 million.

The company said it also expects as loss from continuing operations in the first quarter of 1997 and possibly into the first six months of the years because of a delay in receiving FCC approval for its Playmaker keypad, an unusually large number of seasonal disconnects, hardware related costs, expenses related to the management reorganization, and changes required under FASB 123.

Sokol said the fourth-quarter loss would include $4.3 million for debt cancellations because of management resignations and litigation costs, expenses as a consequence of the buyback of equipment in connection with its discontinuance of certain sale-leaaseback transactions, and charges required under Financial Accounting Standards Board Statement No. 123 in connection with the issuance of warrants to purchase the company's common stock.
